rules.description: Requester cannot approve own gate action (GUARDED gates incl. G-07-02 post C-05)
Dual-control gates require two distinct subject IDs
Engine review release vs HR tier approval — distinct subjects
Ledger export certification — certifier distinct from requester (G-09-06)
Migration cutover sequential approvers must be distinct people (G-14-08)
Protected permission assignment requires admin gate
Compliance Officer cannot be sole approver on own obligation owner reassignment (G-07-02 GUARDED)
rules.notes: Chairman C-05 — Compliance Officer confirmation required
